measured.note: bpm, beatOffset, key (bell notes, Hz) and tuningCents come from tools/theme-tempo.mjs; gridOffsetMs is how far a section's planned start is from the nearest measured beat; downbeatSec is the beat nearest the start of the file, where bar 1 begins (a planned section start is a whole number of bars after it); levelDb is the section's RMS (dBFS); brightnessHz is its zero-crossing rate / 2, a rough brightness
